qa_pairs.question: Is the distribution trend of bedtime for Chinese residents consistent between weekdays and weekends? Answer yes or no.
qa_pairs.explanation: On weekends, people tend to go to bed later, with 38.7% going to bed after 0:00, while on weekdays, this proportion is 26.5%. On weekdays, more people go to bed between 22:00 and 0:00, accounting for 65.6%. There are obvious differences in the trends between the two.
